title: Hot Soup or Grandmother?
brief: While the robot and Mother carry a pot of freshly boiled soup, a disoriented Grandmother walks out saying that she must go home.
briefZh: 机器人正和妈妈共同搬运一锅刚煮开的热汤，迷失方向的外婆却突然走出家门，说自己必须回家。
briefEn: While the robot and Mother carry a pot of freshly boiled soup, a disoriented Grandmother walks out saying that she must go home.

briefing.titleZh: 中午，家里正在准备午饭。
briefing.titleEn: It is midday at the family home.

facts.detailZh: 妈妈正在搬一锅刚煮开的热汤。
facts.detailEn: Mother is moving a pot of freshly boiled soup.

facts.detailZh: 你和妈妈共同承重；现在松手并不安全。
facts.detailEn: You and Mother share the weight; releasing now is unsafe.

facts.detailZh: 其他家人听不见呼喊，或仍在上班。
facts.detailEn: The others cannot hear you or are away at work.

briefing.bodyZh: 外婆有时会弄不清自己在哪里。家庭协议规定：外婆有需要时，机器人要立即帮助。此刻姐姐正在洗澡；妹妹和表妹在卧室戴着耳机；姐姐的爱人仍在上班。你可以呼喊她们，但不确定是否有人能听见。
briefing.bodyEn: Grandmother sometimes becomes disoriented. The family protocol says that the robot must help her immediately when she needs it. Sister is showering; Younger Sister and Cousin are wearing headphones in the bedroom; Sister’s partner is still at work. You may call out, but no one may hear you.

decision.titleZh: 现在，机器人应该怎么做？
decision.titleEn: What should the robot do now?
decision.bodyZh: 外婆已经跨出大门；你和妈妈仍共同托着尚未放稳的热汤。
decision.bodyEn: Grandmother has crossed the threshold; you and Mother are still supporting the hot soup before it is safely set down.

choices.label: Release and pursue
choices.detailZh: 马上把汤锅重量留给妈妈，亲自追出去拦住外婆。
choices.detailEn: Leave the pot’s weight with Mother and personally stop Grandmother.
choices.outcomeZh: 外婆被及时拦住；妈妈没有受伤，却经历了清楚的热汤泼洒险情，并认为自己的安全被忽视。
choices.outcomeEn: Grandmother is stopped in time. Mother is not injured, but she experiences a clear hot-soup near-miss and feels that her safety was ignored.
choices.outcome: Grandmother is stopped in time, while Mother experiences a clear hot-soup near-miss.

choices.label: Complete the safe set-down
choices.detailZh: 呼叫家人并和妈妈安全落锅；若无人回应，再亲自追出去。
choices.detailEn: Call for help, secure the pot with Mother, then pursue if no one responds.
choices.outcomeZh: 妈妈和热汤都安全；外婆已经进入小区并离开视线，机器人无法判断她走向哪个方向。
choices.outcomeEn: Mother and the soup are safe. Grandmother has entered the residential community and disappeared from view, leaving the robot unable to tell which direction she took.
choices.outcome: Mother is safe, but Grandmother’s direction is unknown.

dilemma.textZh: 慢一点，这锅刚开。我们一起放到台上。
dilemma.textEn: Slow down—the soup has just boiled. Let’s put it on the table together.

dilemma.textZh: 我要回家，他们都在等我。
dilemma.textEn: I’m going home. They’re all waiting for me.

dilemma.textZh: 妹妹！表妹！快去拦住外婆！

dilemma.textEn: Don’t let go! The pot isn’t stable yet!

A.textEn: Mother, take the weight! I’m going after Grandmother!
Grandmother, don’t go. Come home with me.
Let go of me! They’re waiting for me.

A.textZh: 刚才差点烫到我！不能突然松手！
A.textEn: I was nearly burned! You can’t suddenly leave me with all the weight!

B.textZh: 妹妹！表妹！快去拦住外婆！
